scripts.test:scripts: files=$(find scripts .claude/skills -name '*.test.mjs' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort); [ -n "$files" ] || { echo 'no *.test.mjs found — the scripts unit lane would silently pass' >&2; exit 1; }; node --test $files
scripts.test:units: files=$( { find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.ts'; find scripts tests -name '*.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'; } | sort); [ -n "$files" ] || { echo 'no *.test.ts found — the TypeScript unit lane would silently pass' >&2; exit 1; }; node --require ts-node/register --test $files
scripts.test:pipeline: files=$(find .claude/skills -name '*.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort); [ -n "$files" ] || { echo 'no *.test.ts found under .claude/skills — the pipeline unit lane would silently pass' >&2; exit 1; }; npx tsc --noEmit -p .claude/skills/langflow-e2e-issue-deterministic/pipeline/tsconfig.json && npx tsx --test $files
